question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left back, Bob is playing left midfielder, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing benchwarmer, and Eve is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Finally, Alice and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) left back
(B) left midfielder
(C) right midfielder
(D) benchwarmer
(E) right winger
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve
Initial: left back | left midfielder | right midfielder | benchwarmer | right winger
1. Eve ↔ Claire: left back | left midfielder | right winger | benchwarmer | right midfielder
2. Claire ↔ Alice: right winger | left midfielder | left back | benchwarmer | right midfielder
3. Bob ↔ Claire: right winger | left back | left midfielder | benchwarmer | right midfielder
4. Bob ↔ Dave: right winger | benchwarmer | left midfielder | left back | right midfielder
5. Alice ↔ Eve: right midfielder | benchwarmer | left midfielder | left back | right winger
Alice plays right midfielder, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
